results.name: Industrial Warehouse
results.description: Industrial Warehouse / Workshop 3D Model featuring a modern steel structure with multiple roller shutter doors, covered loading area, and detailed exterior elements. Optimized for real-time rendering and ideal for industrial environments, logistics centers, factories, construction scenes, architectural visualization, and game development. Clean topology and game-ready for Unity, Unreal Engine, and other 3D applications.

results.name: Moon Ape Lab St Scene
results.description: Frank St. One is a detailed 3D environment that captures the grit and character of a back alley scene. The central feature is a brick wall, brought to life with vibrant, multi-layered graffiti. The urban setting is completed with details like a large metal roller shutter, grimy windows with security grates, and a singular street lamp that adds a moody, realistic glow to the scene. This model is ideal for anyone looking to create a photorealistic backdrop for games, animations, or architectural visualizations.

results.name: Desert Facility Roller Shutter Doors
results.description:

results.name: Modular modernist mediterranean buildings kit
results.description:
Set of two highly optimized and low-poly buildings inspired by modernist Mediterranean and Athenian urban vernacular architecture. Suitable for city builders, VR, or as background city filler. 

FEATURES

Fully separated groups: Every architectural element can be cleanly isolated, repurposed and reconfigured.
Custom textures: Hand-crafted door/window texture maps. 
Modular sub-assets: Balcony variants, roller blinds/shutter system, AC Unit, rooftop boiler and shopfront entrances. 

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Total geometry: 14.8k triangles | 8.3k vertices (entire model, both buildings)
Optimization: Low-poly, mobile/VR and web-engine friendly. 

File format: .DAE (Collada)

Additional: This model can be used for projects focusing on mediterranean urbanism, or realistic background narrative environments.

results.name: Modern Building Design
results.description: The 3D model depicts a modern 4.5-storey semi-commercial building located in Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu, designed to harmonize commercial functionality with comfortable urban living. The structure features a reinforced concrete frame and a sleek contemporary façade combining glass, stone cladding, and painted plaster finishes. The ground floor is dedicated to commercial use, ideal for shops or offices with wide glass frontage and secure roller shutters, while the first and second floors are adaptable for offices, clinics, or rental apartments. The third and fourth floors serve as residential spaces with open-plan living areas, bedrooms, and balconies offering city views, and the half storey at the top includes a utility room and rooftop terrace equipped for solar panels and water tanks. The model emphasizes sustainable urban design through efficient space utilization, natural lighting, rainwater harvesting, and modern aesthetic detailing, reflecting the dynamic mixed-use development trend of Mid-Baneshwor.
